Subject: Capacity extension + isolation confirmation for renewal

Hi Vanessa,

Our renewal with Redwood is coming up (May 15) and we want to lock in an expansion to our Dedicated pool as part of the term amendment. High-level ask: add 12x A100s to our reserved pool (bringing total to 28 GPUs), and confirm physical/logical isolation so our tenants are fully fenced from noisy neighbors. We also need an agreed throughput target (we're targeting sustained 60k tokens/min for our peak ingest window) and any changes to failover behavior if a pool becomes unavailable.

I've attached our capacity spreadsheet with expected profile and traffic windows (capacity_requirements.xlsx). Can you confirm feasibility, estimated delta in monthly committed cost, and a runbook or operations notes that describe the separation/fencing approach? If there's a standard amendment template you prefer to use, send that along.

Happy to do a 30-min sync this week if helpful.

Thanks,
Laura Simmons

Hi Laura — thanks for the note and the spreadsheet. We can support a +12 A100 expansion; initial estimate is a +$16,200/mo commit delta for Dedicated capacity (exact pricing depends on final term length).

Operationally, we propose:
- Create an isolated reserved pool with strict tenant fencing (separate VM group, dedicated NVLink partitions where available).
- Network-level segmentation (VLAN + security groups) plus encryption-in-flight.
- Separate cache namespaces and optional per-tenant KV cache eviction policies.

I've attached a draft term amendment and a first-pass segregation runbook for your review (draft_term_amendment.pdf, segregation_runbook_draft.md). Can we schedule 30 minutes Friday 10:00am PT to walk the runbook and call out any compliance or audit artifacts you need?

Next steps: I will loop in engineering to confirm throughput guarantees and the specific isolation knobs; once we have technical signoff we'll update the amendment and kick off procurement paperwork.

Cheers,

Marissa / Marcus — forwarding Laura's request (Horizon Analytics). They want +12 A100s in their reserved pool and explicit tenant separation plus a throughput target of ~60k tokens/min. They asked for a runbook and any amendments to SLA.

Please confirm:
- Feasibility: can we guarantee 60k tokens/min sustained across the reserved pool (assume mixed sequence lengths; see spreadsheet)?
- Isolation approach: recommended architecture (fenced pool vs tenant namespaces) and any KV cache considerations.
- Time to produce a hardened runbook (we should use this to lock the procurement docs).

If we can hit this with the standard Dedicated architecture + fenced pools, call out any caveats (e.g., degraded throughput during eviction / maintenance windows).

Thanks — Vanessa

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Capacity extension + isolation confirmation for renewal — technical ask

Vanessa — we've reviewed Horizon's sheet and did a quick capacity sketch. Short answer: yes, feasible with the following constraints and mitigations:

Highlights:
- Throughput: 60k tokens/min sustained is achievable on 28x A100s with continuous batching tuned for their sequence distribution. We recommend a 5% buffer for headroom during noisy neighbor activity.
- Isolation: create a fenced reserved pool with physical GPU allocation where supported; where physical partitioning isn't possible, enforce strict tenant affinity + isolated cache namespaces. We'll deploy a dedicated KV cache cluster with namespace-level ACLs to avoid cross-tenant cache contamination.
- Maintenance / failover: documented fallback to compatible lower-TPS model variants and automatic read-only mode for non-critical routes during pool rebuilds; these will be in the runbook.

Deliverables/timeline:
- Runbook v2 (security + audit sections added) — ready for review by EOD Mon 04/05.
- Final throughput validation via 2-hour soak test in staging — schedule next week pending Horizon signoff.

Caveats: if Horizon requires strict hardware-exclusivity (no shared nodes at all), lead time may increase to procure isolated hosts in the requested region and price will adjust. I've attached runbook_v2.pdf (ops and audit sections).

— Marissa
Director, Dedicated Ops
[attachment: runbook_v2.pdf (PDF)]

Hi Laura — quick update and confirmation after our internal review:

1) Commitment: We can extend your Dedicated reservation by +12 A100s (total 28 GPUs). Pricing delta estimate: +$16,200/mo based on a 12-month extension; final numbers will be in the amendment.

2) Isolation: We'll provision a fenced reserved pool with tenant affinity and an isolated KV cache cluster. Runbook v2 (attached) contains the operational steps, audit checklist, and failure modes. If you require hardware-exclusivity, we can do that but it will add lead time and cost — let us know your preference.

3) Throughput & validation: We expect to meet the 60k tokens/min target with continuous batching. Marissa's team will run a 2-hour soak test in staging (dates TBD). Any sustained underperformance identified during validation will trigger a remediation plan per the runbook (fallback model, temporary routing to burst capacity).

4) Docs & procurement: I've attached the current amendment draft and runbook v2. If this aligns, we'll:
   - Update the amendment with final pricing and term length,

   - Schedule the staging soak test and a walk-through of the runbook.
